Chapter 738 - 738 Help; Arrival!

Chapter 738 - 738 Help; Arrival!

738 Help; Arrival!

Lin Fan’s gaze swept across everyone.

Finally, it fell on Qin Xian.

“Mu Jun, may I know why you came here this time?”

Originally, Qin Xian only wanted to be invisible.

Who would have thought that Lin Fan would ask him?

He saw many big shots looking at him.

Hence, he could only bite the bullet and say,” Star Master Lin, this is the Great Elder of the Four Seasons Universe. This is the Master of the Spring Territory. These are the higher-ups and experts of the Four Seasons Universe. We came here to help you.”

“Oh? Help me?”

When Lin Fan heard that, he couldn’t help but take a look at the masked man.

Lin Fan had some understanding of the positions in the Four Seasons Universe.

The Great Elder was an existence whose status was only lower than that of the Four Seasons Universe Master.

No wonder his cultivation had reached Emperor level 4.

“Star Master Lin, thank you for continuously defeating the marine universe army and protecting the Spring Zone.”

Lin Fan said,” I’m sorry, I don’t have any plans to protect the Spring Field. It’s just that someone attacked Earth and I was just defending.””

The Great Elder had obviously expected this answer.

Therefore, he was not too surprised.

He continued,” No matter what, the invasion of the ocean universe is because Star Lord Lin has already encountered a huge obstacle. He has even come to a standstill.”

” Maybe Star Master Lin doesn’t know,” he said after a pause.” It’s precisely because of this obstruction that Ocean Universe Master is completely enraged.”

” According to the news from Four Seasons Universe, Ocean Universe Master is leading an army and preparing to launch a terrifying attack on the Spring Zone, especially Earth!”

As he said this, his tone became heavy.

“After we received the news, we immediately rushed over so that we could work together with Star Lord Lin to resist the ocean universe.”

Lin Fan nodded and didn’t say anything else.

The Great Elder continued,” I have a battle plan here. I wonder what Star Lord Lin thinks.””

” We came here secretly this time, so the marine universe masters probably didn’t get the news. If we hide on Earth and suddenly attack the marine universe army at the critical moment, we’re very confident that we can catch them off guard and even defeat them in one fell swoop!”

When he said this, his tone became extremely high-pitched.

It was as if they had already seen the grand scene of defeating the ocean universe.

Lin Fan glanced at the Great Elder and said,” Thank you so much for coming to help. However, it’s fine if you enter Earth. We don’t like outsiders.””

Even though Lin Fan could easily take care of everyone here.

However, if they were allowed to enter Earth and destroy it, it would be extremely troublesome.

Lin Fan didn’t want that to happen.

As for the threat of the ocean universe, Lin Fan was not afraid at all.

After all, he had already gotten the answer from the system. The ocean universe was unable to break through Earth’s first layer of defense array.

Now, Earth had 15 layers of protective arrays!

“As for the battle plan, I don’t think there’s a need to make it. When you want to help, just help.”

As the sound of his voice faded, a series of notifications rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Ricka has aggro towards you, 3 stars.]

[Ding! Hong Kai has hatred towards you, Hatred Points: 1 star.]

[Ding! Li Jianhu has hatred towards you, Hatred Points: 1 star.]

[Ding! Kai Zhen has hatred towards you, Hatred Points: 1 star.]

….

When Lin Fan heard this, his brows twitched.

Good heavens, these people’s hearts were really smaller than a needle’s eye.

One sentence and they all hated him?

Fortunately, they were not allowed to enter Earth.

Then, Lin Fan placed his attention on Rika, who had 3 stars of Hatred Points.

[Rika: Level 4 Overlord. The Great Elder of the Four Seasons Universe hates you because you refused to let him enter Earth.]

Refusing to enter Earth would result in 3 stars of hatred?

First Elder, the road is too narrow!

Lin Fan took a deep look at the Grand Elder before disappearing into the void like a phantom.

Everyone looked at each other.

Then, there was a burst of discussion.

“Isn’t this Lin Fan a little too condescending?”

“We came over to help out of goodwill, but he actually said that!”

“I’m so angry!”

“Is killing Zach so great? He didn’t know if he killed them alone or if many people killed them together!”

“Let him fend for himself!”

….

The First Elder frowned.

He stared at the earth and the countless roaring spirit dragons.

After a while, his brows relaxed and he said with a smile,”It’s normal for experts to have some pride.”

“We only have one goal, and that is to protect the Four Seasons Universe!”

“Since we can’t enter Earth, we’ll hide further away. At the critical moment, we can still catch them off guard!”

Hearing this, everyone could only nod in agreement.

….

Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan continued to eat barbecued meat with Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others. He was very relaxed and at ease.

After eating his fill, Lin Fan returned to his bedroom and started cultivating.

The reason why his cultivation had improved so quickly was partly because of the system and the dense spiritual energy.

On the other hand, it was because he had worked hard enough.

Time flowed like water in cultivation.

“Phew!”

“Suck!”

Lin Fan continued to use the Ethereal Breathing Technique to gather a large amount of Spirit Qi.

Soon, his entire body was enveloped by spiritual energy.

Sword shadows gradually appeared in the spiritual energy. Fist energy condensed, and metal, wood, water, fire, and earth floated in the air…It was extremely mystical.

Lin Fan’s cultivation state was increasing at a rapid rate.

At the same time, he enjoyed it.

“Phew!”

Lin Fan circulated all of the skills once before letting out a long breath.

A cool breeze immediately swept across the entire Earth.

The trees swayed and the clothes rustled.

“Boom!”

At this moment, a dull sound suddenly appeared on Earth, and it began to shake slightly.

At the same time, a series of notifications rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Level 1 King Stage cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 2 King Stage cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 3 King Stage cultivator detected.]

….

[Ding! Level 2 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 3 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 4 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 5 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator detected.]

When Lin Fan heard this, he opened his eyes wide, shooting out a dazzling light that was like the sun.

Then, he slowly raised his head and looked up into the sky with his pair of Heavenly Eyes.

Suddenly, a sci-fi spaceship that was comparable to a moving planet appeared in the void.

The ocean universe army had arrived!
